why: record friction the OM-005 review met counting term carriers

ops.section: 2026-10-17 tags and sweep: term counts include records matched through a shared word
ops.body: OM-005 (in common), review unit 06. `ks tags --store C:/dev/ONI-Mods/common --node tools/WorkshopUpload` printed 17 for `item-description`, which 3 records carry; the count includes records carrying any term that shares a word with it (`item-visibility`, `item-download`). `ks sweep --store C:/dev/ONI-Mods/common` flagged `screenshots` and `player-log` in TestRunner as single-carrier terms but not `mod-entry-point`, which one record carries, apparently because other terms share the word `mod`. tag-discipline reads the count to check the 3-record floor, so a shared word hides a term under it. Expected: the count of records that declare the term. Done instead: parsed the `**Tags:**` lines with a script and grep.
